# mtncloud_mos_bucket_lifecycle (Resource)

Rules that delete a MOS bucket's objects after some days or on a date, and clean up unfinished uploads. This resource holds all of the bucket's rules; destroy removes them. MOS matches objects by name prefix only (not by tag), and has no storage classes to move objects between.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket_lifecycle" "site" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.name
  rule = [
    {
      id              = "expire-tmp"
      prefix          = "tmp/"
      expiration_days = 7
    },
    {
      id                           = "abandoned-uploads"
      abort_incomplete_upload_days = 2
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name in MOS, usually `mtncloud_mos_bucket.<name>.name`. Changing it moves the setting to another bucket.
- `rule` (Attributes Set) The rules, 1 to 1000. Their order has no meaning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's name.

<a id="nestedatt--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `id` (String) The rule's name, unique in the bucket.

Optional:

- `abort_incomplete_upload_days` (Number) Abort uploads still unfinished this many days after they started, freeing their space.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule runs. Defaults to `true`.
- `expiration_date` (String) Delete objects on this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, at midnight UTC).
- `expiration_days` (Number) Delete objects this many days after they were written.
- `prefix` (String) The rule covers objects whose names start with this. Unset covers the whole bucket.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_bucket_lifecycle.site acme-website
```
